statement: The declared six-dimensional PA-H1 finite image and sixteen-dimensional PA-M2 CI8 phase space cannot be identified by a linear symplectic bijection. Although a symplectic injection exists, it leaves a ten-dimensional complement with nonunique state extension. For positive quartic coupling no affine symplectic injection can match the quadratic PA-H1 Hamiltonian to the unchanged interacting PA-M2 Hamiltonian at all amplitudes. At the PA-M2 zero background no injective full-flow intertwiner exists, even after a constant time rescaling, because the PA-H1 squared frequencies are 9 and 25 while the CI8 linearization has one repeated value r/chi. The CI8 node subspace is not invariant under the unchanged cubic force. Independent additive constants leave each model's dynamics unchanged, so the present records do not identify a common energy zero or a below-empty-space sign. The invariant periodic PA-H1 vacuum cannot derive a nonconstant monotone cooling history, and the continuum ultraviolet symbols do not share one unchanged global Lorentz cone.
verdict: REJECT THE STRICT UNCHANGED PA-H1/PA-M2 IDENTIFICATION; ADVANCE A COMMON THREE-TORUS (T^3) PARENT CONSTRUCTION

separate_exact_obstructions.dimension_and_state: dim V_H=6 and dim V_M=16, so no linear symplectic bijection exists. An explicit symplectic injection leaves a nondegenerate ten-dimensional complement, and positive complement frequencies two and seven give distinct full quasi-free extensions agreeing on the image.
separate_exact_obstructions.all_amplitude_energy: For an affine symplectic map b+A y, the lambda-four coefficient of H_M(b+A lambda y) is g/4 times int phi_(A_Q y)^4. With g>0, equality to a quadratic Hamiltonian for all lambda forces A_Q=0. The derivative image is then pure momentum and isotropic, contradicting symplecticity.
separate_exact_obstructions.zero_background_dynamics: The PA-H1 characteristic polynomial is (s^2+9)(s^2+25)^2. The PA-M2 zero-background CI8 characteristic polynomial is (s^2+r/chi)^8. An injective intertwiner, even with constant time rescaling nu, would require r/(chi*nu^2)=9 and 25 simultaneously.
separate_exact_obstructions.node_regulator_closure: For a CI8 stripe, cos(theta)^3=(3 cos(theta)+cos(3 theta))/4 and 3Q is outside CI8. Projection back is a legitimate regulator choice but changes the unprojected continuum dynamics.
separate_exact_obstructions.energy_reference: The same PA-H1 vacuum has energy zero for dGamma(Omega) and 13/2 for the raw oscillator Hamiltonian, with identical state and dynamics. Independent constants shift any cross-model energy difference arbitrarily.
separate_exact_obstructions.cooling_history: The selected PA-H1 vacuum is invariant. Hence a time-homogeneous functional of that state is constant. The full finite fixture is two-pi periodic, so every continuous globally monotone state-local history on a complete orbit is constant.
separate_exact_obstructions.causal_uv: The PA-H1 KG group speed tends to one. Along a critical PA-M2 continuum axis the group speed grows as 2 sqrt(c/chi) K. This is a global-symbol mismatch, not a denial of the PA-M2 node-local tree-level z=1 cone.
